title: How We Design Your Bespoke Drips
subtitle: Every IV nutrition protocol we design follows a meticulous diagnostic pathway that puts your clinical safety and optimal outcome first:
step1Desc: We review your past and present health conditions to ensure complete clinical safety.
step2Desc: We identify your specific health goals and concerns to target them with precision.
step3Desc: We consider any medications or supplements you're currently taking to avoid interactions.
step4Desc: We analyze your blood test results to assess nutrient and mineral levels accurately.
step5Desc: We customize recommendations to perfectly fit your body, metabolism, and lifestyle.
